ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: API key for Claude model access from console.anthropic.com. Required — the bot cannot start without it.

ASSISTANT_NAME.description: Bot display name. On first startup, a chat group with this exact name is auto-registered as the main group.

TZ.description: Timezone for message timestamps and scheduled tasks (e.g. America/Los_Angeles).

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub personal access token — only needed to install skills from private repos.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Slack Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-...). Leave empty to skip the Slack channel.

SLACK_APP_TOKEN.description: Slack App-Level Token for Socket Mode (xapp-...).

SLACK_MAIN_CHANNEL_ID.description: Optional Slack channel ID auto-registered as the main group on first startup.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather (123456:ABC-...). Leave empty to skip the Telegram channel.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (enable Message Content Intent). Leave empty to skip the Discord channel.

WHATSAPP_PHONE.description: WhatsApp bot phone number in international format, no plus sign (e.g. 12125551234). Leave empty to skip the WhatsApp channel.

ASSISTANT_HAS_OWN_NUMBER.description: Set true only if the WhatsApp number is NOT a secondary number (i.e. the bot owns its only number).

GMAIL_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID for the Gmail channel (Desktop app type). Leave empty to skip the Gmail channel.

GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Google OAuth refresh token (see README for the oauth playground flow).
